doc.title: Emile Barnes, George Guesnon, Little Brother Montgomery, Harold Dejan Interview, 1961-03-11

title: Montgomery plays his unrecorded Satellite Blues
summary: Montgomery announces and sings a new number, Satellite Blues, while Guesnon accompanies and urges him on.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: So long, Curly. But see, people don't know nothing about that, Curly, but nobody but me and among us, we music. Curly's George Gano. See you later. Well, George, now I'm going to make you a number for you to remember while I'm going back to Chicago and other places. I've did so much playing around here until I'm fixing to go out of space. I'm going to make you a number for remembers the Satellite Blues.

Well, brother Montgomery, I'll be glad to get those blues and keep them in my repertoire, so be still now. I'm going to give you an introduction, a double, and come right in behind the double introduction.

I've started an invention. Now it might sound silly to you. Now I've started an invention. Now it might sound silly to you. I was only trying to do something that no other man can do. I made a two-monkey carer up with an electronical engine room.
What are you doing, boy? What are you doing? What are you doing? What are you doing? What are you doing?

I made a two-monkey carer up with an electronical engine room. I was only trying to do something to go and reach the moon. Now I made a sharp-pointed object. Now I made a sharp-pointed object. Just as sharp as anything could be. I was only trying to create something to find the other world for me. Oh, play one, boy. Play one now. Play one. Play one.
Play one. Play one. Yeah, man.
Blow it. Blow it. Blow it, boy. I hear you, Brother Curly. Brother George Gato, Lord.
Play it, Brother Full Bosom. Where you get that Full Bosom shit at?
Now my baby have gone and left me. And she must have gone out of space.
Now my baby have gone and left me. And she must have gone out of space. Play it, Brother Curly. Because I've searched this whole wide world over. And can't find my baby. Play it.
